card.name: Separators between cross-referenced label sections
card.fires_on: The comma after a section number in a bracketed cross-reference such as [see Dosage and Administration (2.3)<< ,>> before the next section title. Also a slash or 'under' in other reference-style text.

modes.label: Comma between cross-references
modes.description: Comma after a numbered section in a [see ...] list, just before the next section name.
modes.example: [see Dosage and Administration (2.1)<< ,>> Warnings and Precautions (5

modes.label: Reference link or pointer words
modes.description: A slash in a web address or the word 'under' pointing to a section name.

card.plain: It fires at the point in a label's cross-reference list where the next section title is about to be named.
